decision_conditions:
Consent is refused for the following works: TPO 01/96 W1 (Oak)

The issue relating to light is considered seasonal by nature and only applies for several months of the year. Additionally, a crown reduction of this nature would invoke a stress response within this tree that would lead to the production of epicormic growth and the activation of dormant buds throughout the crown structure. This would act against the interest of increasing light levels to property as the crown would become denser and so require furthermore frequent and additional works to counteract the stress response. This is all to detriment of the tree’s contribution to the visual amenity of the locality and the wider landscape setting. Additionally, the works regimes that would be required on a frequent basis would impact the trees health and longevity. On the basis of the points discussed, the works would be seriously detrimental to this tree and are refused consent.
